title: Thacker Pass Mine Reclamation Permit — Phase 65 Nevada lithium project delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Nevada lithium project delivery reporting pack. The Thacker Pass reclamation permit defines authorized disturbance, closure and reclamation obligations, and financial assurance exceeding $47 million.
key_findings: The permit establishes a project-specific reclamation obligation.
NDEP reports financial assurance of more than $47 million to support site reclamation.
Financial assurance is a risk-control mechanism, not evidence that reclamation or operating performance has occurred.
why_it_matters: Which records separate land and environmental authorization, financing, construction, commissioning, compliance, qualification, customer acceptance, and repeat output? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. It adds a concrete long-tail liability and financial-assurance layer to the project dossier.
ftfn_relevance: Connects land disturbance to enforceable reclamation obligations.
Creates later checks for bond updates, disturbance, closure, and reclamation outcomes.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
The permit does not prove current disturbance or successful reclamation.
Financial assurance does not establish compliance, production, or local benefit.
